title: INDIA bloc announces upcoming protest rally in Bhopal against Election Commission

tea.why: Opposition parties are protesting against alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.
tea.want: Protesters are demanding action against the Chief Election Commissioner and the scrapping of the electoral roll revision.
tea.changed: Nov 26: Sources reported that the INDIA bloc plans to hold its next anti-CEC rally in Bhopal on December 12.

summary: The INDIA bloc announced plans to expand its campaign against the Chief Election Commissioner over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. According to reports, opposition leaders plan to hold a protest rally in Bhopal on December 12, followed by events in Ahmedabad and Kolkata. The campaign follows previous demonstrations in Delhi, including a gathering at Ramlila Maidan. Opposition parties have accused the Election Commission of vote theft and alleged that millions of names were wrongly deleted from electoral rolls.
demands: Scrapping of the Special Intensive Revision
Action against the Chief Election Commissioner
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Sources reported that the INDIA bloc scheduled a rally in Bhopal for December 12 as part of its anti-CEC campaign.
